veranderings.rede: 'Teen mekaar' suggests pushing against each other; 'teenoor mekaar draai' is the idiomatic way to say the two parts turn relative to each other.
The definite article points to particular wires that were never introduced; the general statement reads more naturally without it, as in the glossary entry.
'Knak' is the natural Afrikaans verb for a joint giving way under a load; a joint does not really 'vou'.
